importantFindings.evidence: App.tsx:668-672 restores the view from history state, and useWindForecast.ts:83-107 refreshes on mount, pageshow, visibilitychange and online. Three texts are narrower than this: the comment at useWindForecast.ts:25-27 ('the Vento screen, which a tap opens'), proposal lines 183-184 and 216 ('Opening Vento is what connects', 'Tapping into Vento connects'), and WeatherScreen.tsx:762 ('Aprendo Vento'). tests/e2e/weather.spec.ts:299 relies on the restore, but only with a fresh copy, and it filters LaMMA out of that assertion.
importantFindings.reproduction: Probe P1, signed out, all hosts mocked or refused. Open Vento, advance the clock 7 hours, reload with no tap. Observed: www.lamma.toscana.it, api.open-meteo.com, ensemble-api.open-meteo.com, api.open-meteo.com. Clock +14 hours and a visibilitychange on the open screen, no tap: the same four requests. Expected from the text: none without a tap.
importantFindings.specRef: 04_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:58; docs/working/WEATHER_PROPOSAL.md section 5 and the merge gate; AGENTS.md section 2
importantFindings.recommendedFix: Not a blocker, because this is an unmerged side branch and the gate is still closed. Before the owner signs, say what they would be accepting: 'an open Vento refreshes by itself on return, on signal back and after a reload'. Or restrict the automatic paths to a Vento opened by tap in this page's life, and make a restored Vento wait for the refresh button. Align the comment and the on-screen line with the choice.

importantFindings.title: A course erased in another tab does not stop Vento: a held answer rewrites the key after the erase, and the tab keeps calling for the erased course
importantFindings.evidence: eraseAllCourseData (courses.ts:100-135) and CourseErase.tsx:56-63 send no broadcast. announceCourseReplacement is called only by import (CourseFiles.tsx:293; localDataOperations.ts:73-75). The reset broadcasts and is therefore safe (probe P5). This weakens proposal line 190 ('erase, replace, import and reset all remove it') and the section 10 row on late answers. The forecast holds no personal data, Home never connects, and a phone-installed PWA rarely has two windows, so I rate it important, not a blocker: no spec or privacy rule is violated, only a claim.
importantFindings.reproduction: Probe P4, same browser context, two pages, synthetic course. Tab A opens Vento with the answers held. Tab B: Impostazioni, Elimina il corso, confirm. Observed: key gone, tab A still on Vento and not on the 'corso cambiato' screen. Release the answers. Observed: key back in storage, plus two new requests from tab A. Create a new course in tab B. Observed: its Home strip reads 'Vento · Sab PM NW 15 kn raffiche 25', the erased course's download, with 0 requests from B. Clock +7 hours and a visibilitychange in tab A: 3 more requests, and the key stays. Expected: key stays gone, tab A stops.
importantFindings.recommendedFix: Broadcast 'changed' from the erase before it clears preferences, so a second tab closes and its hook aborts as it does on reset. This also closes the existing state of a second tab left on an erased course. Add the second-tab case to the spec. Import has a smaller window of the same kind, by code reading: it clears at courseArchive.ts:172 and announces later at CourseFiles.tsx:293. Until then, qualify the proposal's sentence.
